column1: # Windows 11 default service startup types (clean install of Windows 11 Pro 23H2).
# Source: winhelponline.com "Windows 11 Default Services Configuration and Permissions" (display names mapped
# to service names; per-user services listed by their template name). Columns: service name, startup type.
# Used by Services > Backups > "Windows default". Services not listed here are never changed by it.
# Left out on purpose: WlanSvc and WwanSvc - Windows sets them to Automatic when the PC has Wi-Fi / mobile
# broadband hardware (the source PC had none), so the table value would stop wireless connecting at startup.
